verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm BILL Spend & Expense offers "smart, flexible cards" with controlled transactions. The S&E API lets you set up budgets, users, and virtual cards, which covers virtual card issuance tied to budget-based limits. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of physical card issuance, per-card spend limit configuration (as opposed to budgets), any "in minutes" speed claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
